reason: The question asks for the president after an assassination who gave a State of the Union Address when the Civil War ended. The raw candidates mention Johnson and the 1865/1866 addresses, but need to connect Johnson to the assassination and the address timing.

derived_candidates.text: Andrew Johnson became president after the assassination of Abraham Lincoln.
The 1865 State of the Union Address was given by Andrew Johnson after the Civil War ended.
The 1866 State of the Union Address discusses Reconstruction, which began after the Civil War ended.
